CarruselExpos.title: Exhibitions and Appearances
CarruselExpos.paragraph1: Throughout my career, I have had the opportunity to showcase my work in various exhibitions and art fairs, sharing spaces with other artists and connecting with diverse audiences.
CarruselExpos.paragraph2: This selection gathers other notable exhibitions, complementing the institutional collaborations and individual projects I have already presented. Each showcase reflects important moments of my career and artistic evolution.

Ceramic.title: Ceramics
Ceramic.p1: Alongside painting and abstraction, I explore ceramics as a territory of transformation, where earth, fire, and touch converge.
Ceramic.p2: Each piece carries its own voice and pulse, integrating into the broader language of my work. In clay I find both permanence and fragility — the beauty of what endures and the poetry of what breaks.

Gallery.title: Explore my pictorial universe
Gallery.p: Each artwork is an invitation to pause, observe, and be carried away by color, material, and emotion. Enter the gallery and discover the original paintings behind each project.

collab.title: Collaborative Works
collab.description: I have collaborated with institutions and companies such as Fundación Avon, Century 21, and Vonharv, weaving art into spaces of dialogue and transformation. Through workshops and seminars, I invite others to awaken creativity, rediscover the language of intuition, and embrace the quiet courage of expression.

workshop.title: Workshop and Creative Process
workshop.p1: In my studio located in City Bell, I work surrounded by diverse materials—papers, fabrics, and pigments. My process begins with observing the environment and continues through constant experimentation. Each piece emerges from the dialogue between intuition and technique, where matter gains a life of its own.
workshop.p2: Through recycling and reusing materials, I transform objects and supports into works filled with visual energy. Transparency, layering, and texture are constant elements in my aesthetic research.

About.subtitle: Visual artist and designer
About.title: About me
About.paragraph1: I was born in La Plata, Argentina, and I specialize in abstract art. I graduated as a Visual Communication Designer from the Faculty of Fine Arts at the National University of La Plata. I also completed part of my secondary studies in Germany, where my connection with art began. Since 1998, I have continued my training in painting, drawing, and printmaking alongside renowned artists and university professors.
About.paragraph2: My work explores the relationship between color, texture, and emotion, in a process where matter becomes language. Through abstract expressionism, I seek to create a dialogue with the viewer, inviting them to freely interpret each piece.
